verdict.rationale: Angular ships Signals as a first-party reactive primitive (angular-docs-1) which, combined with injectable services, is the documented pattern for shared/global state without external libraries like NgRx. However, the evidence pack never explicitly discusses using Signals+DI as a global state management pattern or contrasts it with third-party state libraries. Missing for 10: explicit docs/guide on global state management via signals+services, and community corroboration that this pattern replaces third-party stores.
